Subject: Your consumer complaint matter

Dear Mr. Gill,

Thank you for meeting us on 28 September 2021 about your dispute with Deccan Constructions. As we understand it, the flat was handed over with serious construction defects. The matter is listed before the Hyderabad District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission.

Our advice is to commission a structural audit report on the defects before the first hearing. Please collect photographs of the defects and a structural audit report and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Tejas Oberoi
